production_verified.label: Production Verified
production_verified.description: Official county production data with row-level source lineage, sync proof, and direct metric recomputation.

production_provisional.label: Production Provisional
production_provisional.description: Operational county data exists, but lineage, conversion, sync, or direct recomputation proof remains incomplete.

sync_derived.label: Sync-Derived
sync_derived.description: TerraFusion operational projection derived from a legacy/source system through TerraFusion Sync.

converted_legacy_sensitive.label: Converted Legacy Sensitive
converted_legacy_sensitive.description: Known or suspected legacy conversion period can affect interpreted fields such as qualified-sale flags.

reference_demo.label: Demo/Reference Only
reference_demo.description: Reference corpus, acquisition registry, demo data, or non-production county coverage. Not certified for operational valuation.

unknown.label: Unavailable / Unknown
unknown.description: County data posture has not been classified.

TerraFusion.Benton.Operational.notes: Benton is the only current operational/provisional production lane, but direct recomputation and conversion-sensitive qualification lineage are still required.

TerraFusion.Benton.LegacyBridge.notes: Bridge layer from Benton legacy/PACS-shaped source data into TerraFusion canonical tables. The bridge is not itself source truth.

TerraFusion.Reference39.Demo.implementation: Washington 39-county acquisition registry and reference/demo corpus
TerraFusion.Reference39.Demo.notes: Proves coverage planning and acquisition paths only. It does not prove official statewide production data.

TerraFusion.Platform.Metadata.notes: Useful for routing, labels, and acquisition posture. Not an assessor source of record.

conversionRisks.risk: Qualified-sale flags may be incomplete, missing, or mapped under different legacy semantics.

countyRules.validationFocus: Benton-first direct source recomputation and sync lineage closure.

countyRules.promotionRequirement: County-specific official source ingestion, lineage proof, sync proof, and direct metric recomputation.
